title: Honor muted Java and Gradle notification sources
reason: Cantrip Code runs marketplace Java tooling inside a web workbench where server-side --disable-extension flags are not propagated to the browser environment. Oracle Java and Gradle can emit repeated nested-project import errors, and upstream source filters still surface error-severity notifications. Extensions cannot change the workbench notification model or establish a source filter before their first notification. This patch gives Cantrip's bundled Java sources quiet defaults and makes an explicit per-source mute suppress error popups while retaining them in the notification center.
validation: Open a Code workspace containing a broken nested Android Gradle project and confirm Java/Gradle errors remain in the notification center without opening popup toasts
removal: Remove if upstream supports true per-source notification suppression and a product-level default source filter, or if the Java tooling stops importing unrelated nested Android projects.
